concerns.text: Task T004 adds extra columns `dataset_id` and `method_id` to `data/results/per_sample_errors.csv`. The contract `per_sample_errors.schema.yaml` defines only the columns `sample_id, dataset, method, prediction, lower_bound, upper_bound, ground_truth, abs_error`. Introducing additional columns violates FR‑005 (output format) and will cause schema validation failures.
